links.comparator_used: Automated prompt optimization compared with the basic prompt for GPT-5 discharge prediction on the hold-out test set.
links.outcome: Same-day hospital discharge prediction performance: F1 score, sensitivity, PPV, and specificity.
links.effect: Baseline GPT-5 prompt achieved an F1 score of 0.48 and sensitivity of 0.37 on the validation set; automated prompt optimization had higher F1 score and sensitivity than the basic prompt on the hold-out test set, with lower PPV and specificity.
links.tradeoff: Lower PPV and specificity with automated prompt optimization.
links.quote: Automated prompt optimization had higher F1 score and sensitivity than the basic prompt on the hold-out test set, with lower PPV and specificity; test-time scaling and expert-led prompt engineering showed minimal improvement.
